text:
deploy-bot: wave-1 rollout: starting deploy 2026.3.1 -> canary-pool-us-east (10%) :rocket:
lauren: seeing spike in 5xx on the canary group, looks like probe failures first, paging the oncall.
sre-bot: alert: canary-error-rate > 3% for service=hosted-api-us-east (5m avg) :rotating_light:
oncall-shift: I'm on it, looking at traces. lauren can you paste a sample error?
lauren: logs show repeated healthcheck timeouts from envoy sidecar, e.g.
```
[2026-03-15T14:12:03Z] upstream connect error or disconnect before headers. code=504 service=llm-runtime
[2026-03-15T14:12:04Z] healthcheck probe timed out after 1s for /healthz
```
lauren: the new sidecar image bumped the probe timeout to 1s in the config we shipped with 2026.3.1 (weird, that seems low)
owen: rolling back to 0% for wave-1 now. toggling rollout flag -> off.
anil: flipping feature flag deploy.wave1=off (via admin-console) — confirmed, traffic back to previous version.
marta: notifying product-support and customers on standby. which customers saw errors?
lauren: error buckets show highest impact on embeddings and streaming endpoints, a subset of requests hitting canary nodes. top affected tenants: acme-inc, greenbox. short spikes but visible.
product-support: alerted customer success, starting outreach for acme-inc (small error window, collecting logs).
oncall-shift: can we confirm healthchecks recovered after rollback?
sre-bot: metrics: canary error-rate dropped from 6.8% -> 0.4 within 45s of flag flip. latency normalized. :white_check_mark:
owen: good. root cause initial hypothesis: sidecar/probe change in 2026.3.1 made liveness threshold too aggressive under normal container start jitter. we'll hold rollout.
lauren: reproducing locally with the new sidecar config: probe deadline 1s causes transient failures under CPU pressure. previous was 3s. looks like a config drift during the build.
anil: file opened: INC-2026-0034, label=canary-flap, assign=sre-team. adding logs and config diff.
marta: can we do a partial re-release with only model/runtime bits excluding sidecar change?
owen: yes. plan: revert probe change in sidecar config, rebuild sidecar, run a small canary with probe=3s and 2 nodes first, monitor for 10m. if stable, re-trigger wave with automated gating.
oncall-shift: I'm going to hand off to evening oncall at 14:30 UTC, leave the flag off. escalation if spikes reappear after revert.
lauren: put the temporary rollback note on the deploy dashboard and add a postmortem TODO. also add an eval run to capture throughput difference with probe change.
product-support: drafting customer notice for impacted tenants, will wait for final RCA before sending.
sre-bot: deploy-bot: mark rollout 2026.3.1 wave-1 aborted (flag=false) and rollback recorded.
deploy-bot: rollout 2026.3.1 wave-1 aborted by oncall at 2026-03-15T14:13:35Z.
oncall-shift: closing handoff: flag off, rollback confirmed, postmortem owner = lauren, followups: fix probe config in CI, add gating rule to detect probe config drift, communicate to customers if RCA > 10m impact.
lauren: thanks everyone. will post a short incident summary in #incidents and start the RCA draft. :memo:
